name: Oak Woodlands Conservation Program
summary: Funding for projects that conserve and restore California's oak woodlands, open to conservation organisations, cities, counties and landowners, with applications taken year-round and Board decisions several times a year.

status.quote: While applications are accepted on a year-round basis, the WCB generally meets four times a year.

applicant_types.quote: The Oak Woodlands Conservation Program offers landowners, conservation organizations, cities and counties, an opportunity to obtain funding for projects designed to conserve and restore California's oak woodlands.

geography.quote: projects designed to conserve and restore California's oak woodlands

access.quote: Information about applying for grants can be found on the WCB Grant Opportunities page.
